correctness.rationale: Each coordinate and vertex weight is explicit; the full covariance and four positive eigenvalues follow from the K_{m,m} adjacency spectrum; equal inverse covariance norms at t solve one polynomial and have average equal to intrinsic dimension. The weighted competitor trace inequality plus arithmetic-geometric mean gives exact volume optimality and uniqueness for arbitrary ellipsoids. Exact SymPy checks confirm the symbolic identities for m=2,3,4,5 and are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The PQ lattice polytopes of balanced complete-bipartite graphs arise naturally from the algebraic power-flow/graph setting and have previously studied lattice invariants. Their intrinsic Euclidean Löwner ellipsoid and exact volume are different mathematical quantities. The nontrivial algebraic splitting into four invariant eigenspaces and the property that every vertex supports the unique global optimum yield a useful structural benchmark beyond mere formula substitution.
